product_summary: Two live web properties were found and read: tushargems.com (Gurugram & New Delhi, 'Certified Gemstones & Rashi Ratan Since 1998', founder/CEO Ravi Kapoor) and tushargems.in ('Buy Loose Gemstones Online | Wholesale Prices', phone +91 9650419710). Real catalogue per the sites: loose certified gemstones — Yellow Sapphire (Pukhraj), Blue Sapphire (Neelam), Pitambari Neelam, White Sapphire, Ruby (Burma, Swiss), Emerald (Zambia), Red/White Coral, Hessonite (Gomed), Cat's Eye, Opal, Pearl (single/multi-line strands), Peridot, Aquamarine, Blue Iolite, Amethyst, Citrine, Blue/Sky Topaz, Garnet, Rhodolite, Tanzanite, Moonstone, Turquoise, Lapis Lazuli, Green Onyx, White Zircon, Tiger Eye, Rose Quartz, Morganite, Sulemani Hakik, Pyrite (raw, in '7 Horses' frames); plus Rudraksha beads (1–14 Mukhi, Nepal/Indian), gemstone rings, pendants, bracelets, necklaces and 'Vastu' combo items. Individual stones are quoted in Ratti with government-lab report numbers (e.g. Report No. 10782D43519, 18165S215009, 6699D25930, 11934D48158) — i.e. cut and polished, certified stones, not rough trade. Sources: https://tushargems.com (home page, product menu, bestseller block) and https://www.tushargems.in (home page, category menu and product listing).
role_hint: trader / retailer — both sites are B2C e-commerce/retail showroom operations (online cart, wishlists, 'Book An Appointment', showrooms in Gurugram and New Delhi, discounted MRP listings). No manufacturing, cutting/polishing facility, mine, or wholesale/export documentation is shown on either site. The .in site advertises 'Wholesale Prices' but presents retail per-piece pricing, so wholesale status is заявлено, не подтверждено. Whether the two domains are the same legal entity is not established from public pages — cannot_verify.
comment: Industry claimed in the batch ('Продукты питания и FMCG' — food/FMCG) is a clear misclassification: the company's actual business is coloured gemstones, pearls, rudraksha and gem-set jewellery. Declared HS 710310 and 710391 are both gemstone codes and are directionally correct, hence 'partial': 7103.10 covers only the rough/raw part of the range (raw pyrite, rough/tumble lots) and 7103.91 covers only ruby/sapphire/emerald — the bulk of the catalogue (peridot, aquamarine, iolite, topaz, garnet, hessonite, cat's eye, opal, tanzanite, amethyst, citrine, etc.) falls under 7103.99, which is missing from the declaration. Also missing: 7101.22 (worked pearls — a major, heavily listed line), 7116.20/7116.10 (gemstone and pearl articles: rings, pendants, bracelets, necklaces, pyrite frames) and rudraksha beads, whose correct heading is uncertain from the pages alone (cannot_verify; likely 1404.90 or 7116.20 depending on presentation). Per project rule 3 this is not a rejection ground — the company stays in the base and the code set should be corrected to 7103.10 + 7103.91 + 7103.99 + 7101.22 + 7116.20 (+ rudraksha heading to be confirmed). All product lines above are taken from the companies' own websites and are therefore 'заявлено, не подтверждено' — no customs line, B/L or GST record was checked in this task (out of scope), so no shipment is corroborated here. Note also that the sites are retail-facing with lab certificates per stone, which is consistent with a domestic retail/wholesale trader rather than a rough-stone exporter; export activity is not evidenced by anything on the pages.
